description: Defines an interface and a no-op implementation for fetching PAC files via DHCP in the Chromium project, including methods for starting fetches, cancelling, and retrieving the PAC URL.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileFetcher
classes.description: Interface for classes that fetch PAC files via DHCP, with methods for fetching, cancelling, and retrieving the PAC URL.

classes.name: DoNothingDhcpPacFileFetcher
classes.description: A stub implementation of DhcpPacFileFetcher that always returns ERR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the PAC script configured via DHCP asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Prepares the fetcher for shutdown, cancelling ongoing operations without callback.

methods.name: GetPacURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the PAC file retrieved from DHCP.

methods.name: GetFetcherName
methods.description: Returns the name of the fetcher, mainly for testing purposes.
